Entries.Name: French Kweebec
Entries.Line: C'est difficile when that tree is a parasite. More literally than I am confortable with.

Entries.Name: French Kweebec
Entries.Line: I do not have the same options that people normally do. It is not like cutting off une mauvaise amitié from your branches.

Line.Text: If you thought that you're getting an explanation, you're sorely mistaken. He moves on without giving it a further shred of attention. Maybe you'll get to know more in the future.

Choices.Text: He did make a good point, though. It feels like you're overplaying your 'Frenchness', like a character.
